mapper.insert: insert into guide_evaluation_report ( batch_no, prompt_version, knowledge_version, total_count, retrieval_hit_rate, answer_accuracy_rate, recommendation_reasonable_rate, context_consistency_rate, tool_call_accuracy_rate, tool_argument_accuracy_rate, tool_result_reference_rate, average_latency_millis, p99_latency_millis, total_prompt_tokens, total_completion_tokens, total_tokens, estimated_cost_yuan, baseline_batch_no, retrieval_hit_rate_delta, answer_accuracy_rate_delta, recommendation_reasonable_rate_delta, context_consistency_rate_delta ) values ( #{batchNo}, #{promptVersion}, #{knowledgeVersion}, #{totalCount}, #{retrievalHitRate}, #{answerAccuracyRate}, #{recommendationReasonableRate}, #{contextConsistencyRate}, #{toolCallAccuracyRate}, #{toolArgumentAccuracyRate}, #{toolResultReferenceRate}, #{averageLatencyMillis}, #{p99LatencyMillis}, #{totalPromptTokens}, #{totalCompletionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{estimatedCostYuan}, #{baselineBatchNo}, #{retrievalHitRateDelta}, #{answerAccuracyRateDelta}, #{recommendationReasonableRateDelta}, #{contextConsistencyRateDelta} )

insert into guide_evaluation_item ( batch_no, case_id, case_name, question, expected_goods_id, actual_goods_id, reference_passed, answer_passed, recommendation_passed, context_passed, actual_tool_names, tool_call_passed, tool_argument_passed, tool_result_reference_passed, latency_millis, llm_latency_millis, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, estimated_cost_yuan, fallback_used, score, suggestion ) values
( #{batchNo}, #{item.caseId}, #{item.caseName}, #{item.question}, #{item.expectedGoodsId}, #{item.actualGoodsId}, #{item.referencePassed}, #{item.answerPassed}, #{item.recommendationPassed}, #{item.contextPassed}, #{item.actualToolNames}, #{item.toolCallPassed}, #{item.toolArgumentPassed}, #{item.toolResultReferencePassed}, #{item.latencyMillis}, #{item.llmLatencyMillis}, #{item.promptTokens}, #{item.completionTokens}, #{item.totalTokens}, #{item.estimatedCostYuan}, #{item.fallbackUsed}, #{item.score}, #{item.suggestion} )

insert into guide_evaluation_feedback ( batch_no, target_type, priority, content ) values
( #{batchNo}, #{feedback.targetType}, #{feedback.priority}, #{feedback.content} )
mapper.select: select batch_no, prompt_version, knowledge_version, total_count, retrieval_hit_rate, answer_accuracy_rate, recommendation_reasonable_rate, context_consistency_rate, tool_call_accuracy_rate, tool_argument_accuracy_rate, tool_result_reference_rate, average_latency_millis, p99_latency_millis, total_prompt_tokens, total_completion_tokens, total_tokens, estimated_cost_yuan, baseline_batch_no, retrieval_hit_rate_delta, answer_accuracy_rate_delta, recommendation_reasonable_rate_delta, context_consistency_rate_delta from guide_evaluation_report order by id desc limit 1

select case_id, case_name, question, expected_goods_id, actual_goods_id, reference_passed, answer_passed, recommendation_passed, context_passed, actual_tool_names, tool_call_passed, tool_argument_passed, tool_result_reference_passed, latency_millis, llm_latency_millis, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, estimated_cost_yuan, fallback_used, score, suggestion from guide_evaluation_item where batch_no = #{batchNo} order by id asc
select target_type, priority, content from guide_evaluation_feedback where batch_no = #{batchNo} order by id asc
